name: viralhunt-mcp
description: MCP server for ViralHunt.io: find trending/viral content across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS; learn the best time to post per network from measured viral posts; get top hashtags, trending sounds and the best subreddits or Bluesky feeds for a topic; and schedule/publish/edit posts on your connected social accounts.
